approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content, with file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
notes: Reproduce an Email Date-header answer that borrows a Received date from the same exact citation.
Keep each explicit Email date or Date-header claim equal to one complete cited Date header value.
Reject timestamp recombination and cross-Email source-finding borrowing.
Do not treat Received, body dates or RFI/Submittal form Date fields as Email Date headers.
Require an explicit complete header value when an answered question asks for one or more Email dates or Date headers.
For a natural sent-date question, require that Date header or a separately labelled exact Sent date rather than Received or body text.
Preserve weekday, date, time, seconds, numeric offset and comments without timezone conversion or delivery-time inference.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Ground Email Date-header claims
objective: Prevent Email Date-header values from being omitted, recombined or borrowed from Received, body, workflow-form or another Email source while retaining exact readable timestamp output.
